options.label: Annotated pairs CSV
options.help: CSV columns: image, labels, specimen_id, split; split is train, validation or test.

options.label: Voxel spacing Z,Y,X
options.help: Use one physical unit consistently in training TIFFs and counting images.

options.label: Voxel spacing unit
options.help: Use the same unit as calibrated input stacks (um, nm, mm or pixel). No automatic resampling.

options.label: Normalization lower percentile
options.help: Per-volume normalization used consistently during training and inference.

options.label: Normalization upper percentile
options.help: Normalization changes model input only; measurements use original pixels.

options.label: Training patch Z,Y,X
options.help: Patch dimensions must fit every training/validation image and be divisible by grid times 2^depth.

options.label: Prediction grid Z,Y,X
options.help: Each entry must be a positive power of two.

options.label: Boundary rays
options.help: Number of directions describing each star-convex 3D object.

options.label: Network depth
options.help: Depth of the upstream StarDist U-Net backbone.

options.label: First-level features
options.help: Increasing features increases memory and training time.

options.label: Total epochs
options.help: Resume may extend this ceiling; other training settings must match.

options.label: Batches per epoch
options.help: Random labelled patches sampled per epoch.

options.label: Augment training patches
options.help: Random axis flips and intensity changes; held-out images are not augmented.

options.label: Random seed
options.help: Recorded for repeatable training and generated examples.

options.label: Fit thresholds on validation data
options.help: Choose model thresholds using validation specimens only; untouched test data stay held out.

options.label: Prediction tiles Z,Y,X
options.help: Increase for volumes that exceed prediction memory.

options.label: CPU threads
options.help: Managed CPU TensorFlow environment; no manual Python setup.
